title: Godot 4.7 Beta版来了！
text:
女士们先生们大家好
我是game from scratch的mike ga

所以在这次的实操环节中
我会重点介绍我认为最酷的新功能

如果你有兴趣
当然可以自己去查阅
在动画方面确实有一些改进
他们在DEV2版本中忘记提到的一点是

# Godot 4.7 Beta 功能图谱

## 总览图
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    BetaRelease["4.7 Beta 发布"]
    FeatureFreeze["所有新增功能已冻结"]
    RegionLight["区域光（Rectangular Light）"]
    HDR["HDR 支持"]
    AwaitTrainer["await trainer（补间动画）"]
    GroupCopyPaste["组复制/粘贴"]
    VertexSnap["顶点吸附（B键）"]
    NewJoystick["内置虚拟摇杆"]
    OneWayCollision["单向碰撞"]
    DrawableTexture["可绘制纹理 API"]
    BilinearFilter["双线性过滤"]
    AssetDiscount["春季限时 SP60 折扣"]
    ShaderPreview["着色器预览器（内置）"]
    UIFontMono["UI 字体改为等宽"]
    RemoteView["远程视图显示对象信息"]

    BetaRelease --> FeatureFreeze
    BetaRelease --> RegionLight
    BetaRelease --> HDR
    BetaRelease --> AwaitTrainer
    BetaRelease --> GroupCopyPaste
    BetaRelease --> VertexSnap
    BetaRelease --> NewJoystick
    BetaRelease --> OneWayCollision
    BetaRelease --> DrawableTexture
    BetaRelease --> BilinearFilter
    BetaRelease --> AssetDiscount
    BetaRelease --> ShaderPreview
    BetaRelease --> UIFontMono
    BetaRelease --> RemoteView
```

## 区域光使用流程
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Create["创建矩形光源"]
    Position["定位到屏幕上"]
    Scale["缩放匹配屏幕大小"]
    Rotate["旋转使正面朝前"]
    SetTex["指定投影纹理"]
    Energy["调高光能量"]
    Atten["降低衰减"]
    Enable["打开区域光"]
    Result["投射光线效果"]
    Compare["与普通光对比"]

    Create --> Position --> Scale --> Rotate --> SetTex --> Energy --> Atten --> Enable --> Result
    Result --> Compare
```

## 动画改进链路
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    AwaitTrainer["await trainer"]
    Tween["补间动画"]
    Signal["收到特定信号后继续"]
    Split["动画拆分"]
    Collapse["在编辑器中折叠"]
    Navigate["在动画组中导航"]
    Clear["清除杂乱内容"]

    AwaitTrainer --> Tween --> Signal
    AwaitTrainer --> Split --> Collapse --> Navigate --> Clear
```

## 编辑器交互增强
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    GroupCopy["组复制/粘贴"]
    Select["选择组"]
    CopyVals["复制全部数值"]
    PasteVals["粘贴到目标"]
    Duplicate["快速克隆对象"]
    VertexSnap["顶点吸附"]
    HoldB["按住 B 键"]
    SnapVertex["吸附到最近顶点"]
    ReleaseB["松开 B 键"]
    PathSnap["路径吸附到碰撞体"]
    CollisionSnap["碰撞体吸附"]
    UIFont["UI 字体等宽化"]
    RemoteID["远程视图显示对象ID+名称"]
    AssetDetails["资产库显示更多细节"]
    SearchMenu["弹出菜单搜索/筛选"]

    GroupCopy --> Select --> CopyVals --> PasteVals --> Duplicate
    VertexSnap --> HoldB --> SnapVertex --> ReleaseB
    PathSnap --> CollisionSnap
    UIFont --> RemoteID
    AssetDetails --> SearchMenu
```
